system.description:
• Effect: Uses per day equal to your Charisma modifier + 2 (minimum 3), +1 at 5th level and again at 15th (see the Paladin Progression Table). Your Channel options:
  • Smite (the default): spend a use when you hit (not before rolling).
  • The hit deals extra radiant damage equal to your Paladin level, and one ally within 10ft regains HP equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).
  • Your first hit each encounter Smites automatically unless you choose to save the use.
  • Smite can be used against any foe, regardless of alignment.
  • One Smite a round; Blessed Weapon adds to it. 5th level: your Smite also deals +1d8 radiant damage (2d8 from 15th)

activities.name: Smite
activities.text: The default Channel, spent when you hit (not before rolling): the hit deals extra radiant damage equal to your Paladin level, against any foe regardless of alignment. Your first hit each encounter Smites automatically unless you choose to save the use (the attack card's Smite button). Then roll the ally's healing below (no use spent). One Smite a round; Blessed Weapon adds to it.

activities.name: Smite: an ally heals
activities.text: With your Smite: one ally within 10ft regains HP equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

activities.name: Smite: +1d8 radiant (2d8 from 15th)
activities.text: With your Smite: +{5:1d8, 13:2d8} radiant damage. One Smite a round.

activities.name: Turn Undead
activities.text: As your action: turn undead as a Cleric 2 levels lower than your Paladin level; the Turn DC is your Class Save DC, using Charisma. Destruction from 8th effective turning level, if the undead's Level is no more than half that level.

activities.name: Heaven's Answer: reroll
activities.text: Costs 2 uses. Right after the roll, reroll one d20 or damage roll of your own. You can do this out of turn.

activities.name: Heaven's Answer: halve damage
activities.text: Costs 2 uses, when you take damage: halve it, and all further damage you take until the start of your next turn. You can do this out of turn.

activities.name: Heaven's Answer: cleanse
activities.text: Costs 2 uses, as your action, by touch: end every disease and the Blinded, Deafened, Poisoned, Charmed, Frightened and Confused conditions on one creature.
